segments.text: GitLog. It turns your Git history into a cinematic animated replay right inside your terminal. Instead of scrolling through raw commits, GitLog lets you
watch your project evolve with realistic typing animations and file changes almost like your codebase is telling its own story. It supports tree sitter
syntax highlighting across 26 languages, shows a live project file tree with change stats, and even includes a screen saver mode that plays random commits endlessly.
